svg.title: Medicare — icon-based application architecture
svg.desc: Patients, care teams and administrators use the React application hosted on Vercel. Its same-origin API proxy forwards requests to the Node.js and Express API on Render. Session, role, ownership, active-care and consent checks protect access to a private PostgreSQL schema on Supabase, which retains clinical records and audit evidence. Dashed connections show separately configured ClamAV scanning, durable AES-256-GCM file storage, SMTP delivery and optional FastAPI intake. These services are not represented as already provisioned.
svg.metadata: Brand icons: Simple Icons, CC0-1.0. Pinned provenance and license: docs/assets/icons/simple-icons/sources.json and LICENSE.md. Generic architecture symbols are original project artwork.

g.text: Patient-controlled care, from the browser to the private data boundary.
